battle.name: 延州之戰
battle.brief: 康定元年(1040)秋,西夏主李元昊稱帝後遣兵進攻宋鄜延路治所延州(今陝西延安),攻城不克;宋廷震動,詔以韓琦、范仲淹鎮陝西,范仲淹兼知延州,整軍修城、練民兵寨兵,延州自此成為西北樞紐。卡面的希臘火是七世紀拜占庭的海戰燃燒武器,距此役三百七十年,不可能出現在延州城下。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 這場戰爭是北宋與西夏在陝西北部的一場邊境攻防，時間在宋仁宗康定元年(1040)，正是李元昊正式建國稱帝的同一年。北宋一方以陝西四路邊軍為主力：永興軍路治府州(今陝西榆林)，鄜延路治延州(今陝西延安)，環慶路治環州(今甘肅環縣)，秦鳳路治秦州(今甘肅天水)，宋夏接觸的第一線就鋪在這四路之間；兵員以中央禁軍為骨幹，邊州另募民兵、寨兵與弓箭手，專司城守與屯田。指揮系統上，中樞由樞密院掌兵，仁宗卻以韓琦為陝西四路經略安撫使、范仲淹為經略安撫副使兼知延州，把西北兵權交到兩名文臣手上，這在北宋前期極為罕見，說明廷中已把此役視為關係國運的大事。後勤以關中為基地，糧秣由耀州、坊州北運至延州，弓矢弩材由成都府、湖州、洋州沿棧道東調，鎧甲由京師配給。西夏一方是李元昊新立的大夏：都興慶府(今寧夏銀川)，元昊自稱天錫禮法延祚，拒絕宋廷冊封而自立；軍隊以能步射的騎兵為主，其中「擒生軍」精騎人馬皆備重甲，被宋人稱為鐵鷂子，是夏軍最具衝擊力的機動力量，並以步卒、攻城器械與火器配合。第三方中，契丹(遼)居北方虎視，吐蕃(青唐)與宋保持和好，宋廷必須同時維持西北與西南兩線的穩定，這是它無法傾盡全力一次滅夏的現實原因。
countriesEn: This war was a frontier clash between the Northern Song and Western Xia in the north of Shaanxi, fought in Kangding year one (1040), the very year in which Li Yuanhao proclaimed himself emperor and founded the state of Great Xia. On the Song side the fighting was carried by the frontier armies of the four circuits of Shaanxi: Yongxingjun circuit with its seat at Fuzhou (present-day Yulin), Fuyan circuit with its seat at Yanzhou (present-day Yan'an), Huanqing circuit with its seat at Huanzhou (present-day Huan County in Gansu) and Qinfeng circuit with its seat at Qinzhou (present-day Tianshui in Gansu); the first line of contact between the two states ran across these four. The backbone of their strength was the central imperial army, supplemented at the border towns by militia, garrison peasants and locally raised archers whose business was to hold the walls and to farm their own grain. On the command side the Central Military Affairs Commission kept the army in the capital, yet Emperor Renzong handed the north-west to two civilians, Han Qi as Pacification and Administration Commissioner of the four circuits and Fan Zhongyan as his deputy and concurrently governor of Yanzhou; that such men should be sent was highly unusual in the early Northern Song and shows that the court had come to treat this war as a matter of state survival. Logistically the Song based itself on the Guanzhong plain: grain and provisions moved north from Yaozhou and Fangzhou to Yanzhou, bows, arrows and crossbow stock travelled east from Chengdu prefecture, Huzhou and Yangzhou up the plank road through the mountains, and armour was issued from the capital. On the Xia side stood the new state of Great Xia of Li Yuanhao, with its capital at Xingqing prefecture (present-day Yinchuan); Yuanhao took the title Tianxi Lifa Yanzuo, refused recognition by the Song court, and built an army whose strength lay in mounted archers, among them the elite captured-living corps, whose men and horses were both heavily armoured and whom the Chinese called the iron partridges, the most striking mobile force of the Xia army, supported by infantry, siege machines and incendiary weapons. Among the third parties the Khitan Liao watched from the north, while the Tibetan state of Qingtang kept friendly relations with the Song; the Song court could not concentrate everything on destroying Xia without endangering the other front, and that was the plain reason why the war had to be fought as a long contest of supplies rather than a single decisive stroke.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的人分屬兩邊。宋方最關鍵者是范仲淹。康定元年冬，朝廷以他為陝西四路經略安撫副使兼知延州，他於翌年春入延州任事；到任之後他不動聲色地替這條戰線換了骨架：整頓軍紀，汰弱留強，把禁軍與邊民兵寨編為真正用得上的隊伍；修築延州城與沿邊堡寨，形成城、寨、堡梯次防守；招集邊民為義勇、募弓箭手屯田屯糧，以民養兵；並在驛遞與烽燧之間重新理順命令與警報的傳遞，使延州從一個被動的邊城變成可以主動出擊的支點。韓琦以陝西四路經略安撫使總攬全局，與范仲淹同籌兵糧，兩人奏請朝廷增兵、增糧、延長軍期，把短暫的接戰改成可以持久消耗的邊防格局。曹英是秦鳳路副都部署，康定二年二月在渭州定川寨一役中兵敗陣亡，那場敗仗震動朝野，也逼出了范仲淹請修防線、建城置寨之議。麟州折氏(折稜、折克俊一輩)長期守禦府州，是宋方在西北另一支可以牽制夏軍的力量，與延州、環州互為犄角。夏方主導者是李元昊，元氏以弓騎立國，未及即位便索官爵、拒漢使、斷使禮，康定元年三月稱帝後即以兵相向；延州一線正是他選擇的第一個硬目標，因為拿下鄜延路治所，就等於撬開宋在西北的整條防線。雙方將佐之中，還有許多沒有留下姓名的邊將，其死守與潰散同樣記在這場戰爭的卷頁裡。
peopleEn: The man who shaped the outcome of this war on the Song side was Fan Zhongyan. In the winter of Kangding year one the court appointed him Pacification and Administration Deputy Commissioner of the four circuits of Shaanxi and concurrently governor of Yanzhou, and he took up the post in the spring of the following year. Once there he quietly replaced the skeleton of this front line: he tightened discipline, weeded out the weak and kept the strong, and reorganised the imperial soldiers together with the local militia and garrison peasants into a force that could actually be used; he repaired the walls of Yanzhou and the stockades along the frontier so that cities, forts and blockhouses formed a tiered defence; he enrolled the border population as volunteers, recruited archers and set them to farm and to grow their own grain, so that the troops fed themselves; and he reworked the courier posts and beacon stations so that orders and alarms could move between Fuyan, Suizhou and Huanzhou in a matter of days. Yanzhou thus changed from a passive border town into a hinge from which the Song could even strike out. Han Qi, as Pacification and Administration Commissioner of the four circuits, directed the whole theatre and worked out the numbers of men and grain with Fan, petitioning the court for more soldiers, more provisions and longer terms of service, and so converting a brief encounter into a frontier posture built for attrition. Cao Ying, deputy commander of Qinfeng circuit, was killed when the Song army was beaten at Dingchuan stockade in the second month of Kangding year two; that defeat shook the court and produced the proposal, from Fan, for new fortified lines. The Zhe clan of Linzhou, in the line of Zhe Rong and Zhe Kechun, held Fuzhou for generations and gave the Song a second force in the north-west able to pin the Xia army, working in concert with Yanzhou and Huanzhou. On the Xia side the driving figure was Li Yuanhao, who had raised his state on the bow and the horse; even before his enthronement he had demanded formal titles from the Song, refused Song envoys and cut the ritual of envoys adrift, and once he had proclaimed himself emperor in the third month of Kangding year one he moved at once to the use of arms. Yanzhou was the first hard target he chose, because taking the seat of Fuyan circuit was the surest way to lever the Song's entire north-western line out of place. Many of the officers and soldiers on both sides left no names behind them, and their stubborn holding and their routs are recorded just as much in the pages of this war.
kits: 卡面這件希臘火是七世紀上半葉拜占庭(東羅馬帝國)的產物，約670年前後開始用於帝國的海上戰爭：把配方的燃燒劑裝在銅管或銅罐中，點燃後拋射，或固定在船首衝撞敵船，配方被視為帝國最高機密，據說配方隨一艘沉船一同失落。它距康定元年(1040)的延州城攻防有三百七十年，地理上隔著半個歐亞大陸，技術上也不屬於同一條線——希臘火倚賴的是天然瀝青類的燃油與專門的銅管發射具，且主要用於水面；延州城下既無海戰可打，宋夏兩軍也沒有任何一支在使用希臘火。與希臘火功能最接近、當時確實存在的，是宋軍的猛火油柜：以筒管盛燃油料，藉砲或唧筒擲射或噴出，用於焚燒攻城器械與敵人攻具；此外還有火矢(以火藥或油脂點燃的箭)與火藥兵器——慶曆四年(1044)刊行的《武經總要》把火藥箭、突火槍正式著錄，正說明火藥武器正在這幾年成熟。與希臘火同屬射擊武器家族的是弩與強弩：宋軍的神臂弓、拉弓的川弓大弓，射程以數百步計，是攻城與野戰的骨幹；步卒配長矛、直刀與皮甲牌，城頭另備拒馬、鹿角、壕塹與望雲車、巢車等觀敵器械，投石砲則以砲石打擊城牆與聚集的軍隊。西夏方面，鐵鷂子(擒生軍)以重甲騎兵配長弓與短弩，兼有步卒的長矛、刀、標槍，攻城用雲梯、穴城(掘地道)與拋石，火器方面同樣有火砲與火矢。交通與補給方面，宋軍靠騾馬馱載與輜重車，軍馬取自西北牧場與京師，糧食自關中沿渭河北運；夏軍則以騎兵就食，隨軍帶大量牲畜作肉食與燃料。希臘火之所以仍被放上這張卡，正因為它與猛火油柜、火矢同屬「把燃燒物質投送到敵人身上」這一技術家族。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on the card is a product of the first half of the seventh century in Byzantium, the Eastern Roman Empire, first used in the empire's naval warfare from about 670: a burning mixture made to a secret formula was loaded into copper tubes or jars, lit, and either thrown or fixed to the prow to ram enemy ships, the formula being treated as the empire's highest state secret and, according to the story, lost with a ship that sank. It stands three hundred and seventy years before the fighting at Yanzhou in 1040, on the far side of Eurasia geographically and on a different line of technology altogether: Greek fire depended on natural bituminous fuel and on a purpose-built copper launching device, and it was essentially a weapon of the water surface. There was no sea fight to be had under the walls of Yanzhou, and neither the Song nor the Xia army was using anything remotely like Greek fire. What came closest in function, and certainly existed at the time, was the Song incendiary oil projector, in which a tube held fuel oil that was thrown or blown out by a catapult or a piston to set fire to siege engines and enemy assault devices; alongside it came fire arrows, ignited with gunpowder or oil, and gunpowder weapons, for the Wujing Zongyao printed in 1044 formally recorded the gunpowder arrow and the fire lance, showing exactly how rapidly the gunpowder weapons were maturing in those years. In the same equipment family as the bow were the crossbows and heavy crossbows of the Song: the powerful divine arm bow and the large Sichuan bows, with a range measured in several hundred paces, formed the backbone of both siege and field work; foot soldiers carried long spears, straight sabres, leather armour and shields, while the walls carried chevaux-de-frise, abatis, ditches and observation structures such as the cloud-gazing tower and the nest tower, with stone-throwing catapults used to hit walls and massed troops. On the Xia side the iron partridges, the elite cavalry corps, were heavy-armoured riders armed with longbows and short crossbows, supported by infantry with spears, sabres and javelins, while their siege equipment included scaling ladders, mining tunnels driven under the walls and traction trebuchets, and they too had incendiary stones and fire arrows. On movement and supply the Song relied on mules and donkeys and on baggage wagons, its warhorses drawn from the pastures of the north-west and from the capital, with grain moving north along the Wei river from Guanzhong; the Xia cavalry lived off the country as it moved, taking large numbers of animals with them for meat and for fuel. Greek fire is on this card precisely because it belongs, with the oil projector and the fire arrow, to one technological family: the business of getting a burning substance onto the enemy.
tactics: 西夏的攻勢是一套典型的邊地強攻：以鐵鷂子為先鋒，傾巢而出的騎兵先掃清城外的拒馬、陷馬坑與巡邏隊，切斷城郊樵採與糧秣運輸，再把主力集中到城牆的一二處做重點突擊；步卒則推雲梯、掘穴城(地道)接近城基，同時用拋石砲打擊城頭的守軍與集結的隊形，火矢覆蓋城垛，試圖在守軍換班、器械損壞時登城。圍城之後，夏軍並不急於強攻，而是以騎兵游戈封鎖道路，等待宋廷的援軍趕到再打第二段——這正是宋廷最怕的局面。延州的守方則倚城為堅：城頭以神臂弓與弓弩覆蓋城壕，砲石打擊逼近的器械與密集的攻城部隊，步卒在城垛後以長矛抵拒登城的敵手，並在城的各處設伏兵與突擊隊，俟夏軍攻城疲憊或陣腳一亂就出城反擊，不與其正面纏鬥。范仲淹到任後把這種被動的點防守改為體系防守：在延州城外及沿線要地修築堡寨，令城、寨、堡三級互相策應；把民兵與寨兵編組屯田，常駐邊地生產，軍糧不再全賴遠程轉運；重整驛遞與烽火報警，使鄜延、綏州、環州之間的呼叫可以在數日之內傳到；並把出城游擊與斷糧作為常態手段。整條補給線的弱點也在戰術中被放大：宋軍糧道自關中經耀州、坊州北運，夏軍攻綏德、環州、渭州，其實就是繞到宋軍側後，切斷水源與糧道；康定二年二月定川寨的敗仗，正是宋軍野外部隊離開城池太遠、掩護不足的結果。
tacticsEn: The Xia assault followed the classic pattern of a frontier attack by force. The iron partridges led: cavalry poured forward to sweep away the chevaux-de-frise, the horse-pits and the patrolling parties outside the walls and to cut off wood-cutting and grain movement in the district round the city, and then the main body was concentrated on one or two points of the wall for a heavy assault. Infantry brought up scaling ladders and drove mining tunnels under the foundation while traction catapults flung stones at the defenders on the ramparts and at the formations massed behind them, and fire arrows swept the parapets, in the hope of storming the wall at the moment when the garrison was changing shift and its engines were damaged. Having ringed the city the Xia did not hurry into a frontal assault: their cavalry roved to seal the roads and waited for the Song relief army to arrive before striking again, which was precisely the situation the court most feared. The Song defence at Yanzhou rested on the strength of the walls: the divine arm bows and the other crossbows covered the ditch from the parapet, catapult stones struck at the engines closing in and at the massed assault columns, the foot held the ladder-heads with long spears, and troops were posted in ambush behind the battlements and in the streets, ready to sally when the Xia attack faltered rather than to stand and grind in an open fight. After Fan's arrival this passive defence of a single city was turned into a system: stockades and blockhouses were built outside Yanzhou and at the key points along the line, so that city, fort and blockhouse could support one another; the militia and garrison peasants were organised into farming garrisons that held the frontier in permanent residence and produced their own grain, so that the army no longer depended entirely on long-range transport; the courier posts and the beacon network were reworked so that a call from Fuyan could reach Suizhou or Huanzhou in a matter of days; and raiding the enemy's supplies and cutting his food was made a permanent task rather than an emergency. The weakness of the whole supply line was magnified by the tactics on both sides: the Song grain route ran north from Guanzhong through Yaozhou and Fangzhou, and the Xia attacks on Suizhou, Huanzhou and Weizhou were movements round the Song flank to cut the water and the grain, while the defeat at Dingchuan in the second month of Kangding year two was the direct result of Song field columns operating too far from the walls without proper cover.
data: 時間與地點可先說清楚。西夏主李元昊在康定元年三月(部分史籍作四月)正式稱帝，改元天錫禮法延祚；同年秋末冬初，夏兵進攻鄜延路，延州城未被攻破；同年十一月，宋廷以韓琦、范仲淹鎮陝西；康定二年二月，西夏攻渭州定川寨，宋軍大敗，兵馬死者以萬計；三月范仲淹奏請在環州與鎮戎軍之間築大順城以為拒夏之堡；此後雙方在陝西、聯絡吐蕃、控制橫山一帶反覆拉鋸，直到慶曆四年(1044)宋夏和議，戰事暫告一段落。距離上，延州(今延安)距京師開封約一千三百里，距西夏都城興慶府(今銀川)約九百里，北至麟州(今神木)二百餘里，東至鄜州(今子長)百餘里；這幾個數字說明延州正好卡在宋夏兩國之間的交通腰身上。兵力方面，現存史籍沒有留下延州攻防雙方的精確人數，只能從宋廷的處置看出規模：朝廷自京師、河東、河北調禁軍赴陝西，總數以萬計；范仲淹、韓琦奏請增兵增糧，把陝西軍費列為常支。武器性能有兩個數字可引：宋軍強弩神臂弓的射程以數百步計，西夏鐵鷂子的長弓在宋人記載中約三百步可引而命中。物資生產上，成都府、湖州、洋州等地每年供應西北的弓矢以數十萬計，軍馬來自西北牧場；一場邊境攻守消耗的正是這些弓弦、箭桿、馬料與糧食。
dataEn: The dates and the ground can be set out first. Li Yuanhao proclaimed himself emperor in the third month of Kangding year one (some records make it the fourth), taking the era title Tianxi Lifa Yanzuo; in the late autumn and early winter of that same year the Xia army attacked Fuyan circuit and failed to take Yanzhou; in the eleventh month of the same year the court sent Han Qi and Fan Zhongyan to Shaanxi; in the second month of Kangding year two the Xia attacked Dingchuan stockade in Weizhou and the Song army was beaten, the dead being counted in tens of thousands; in the third month Fan Zhongyan petitioned to build the great fortified town of Dashun between Huanzhou and Zhenrong Army to hold the Xia off; after that the two sides kept grinding at one another over Shaanxi, the reaching out to the Tibetans and the control of the Hengshan range, until the Song-Xia settlement of 1044 closed the fighting for a time. As for distances: Yanzhou (present-day Yan'an) lies about thirteen hundred li from the capital Kaifeng and about nine hundred li from the Xia capital of Xingqing (present-day Yinchuan), some two hundred li north of Linzhou (present-day Shenmu) and a little over a hundred li east of Douzhou (present-day Zichang); those figures show exactly why Yanzhou sat on the waist of the road between the two states. On the numbers of men, the transmitted histories preserve no precise count of either side at the siege of Yanzhou, and the scale can only be read from what the court did, and it was large: troops were drawn from the capital and from Hedong and Hebei for service in Shaanxi, counted in tens of thousands, and Han Qi and Fan Zhongyan petitioned for more men and more grain, making Shaanxi military expenditure a standing item of the budget. Two figures can be quoted for weapons: the effective range of the Song divine arm bow was several hundred paces, and the longbows of the Xia iron partridges were recorded by the Chinese as drawing and hitting at about three hundred paces. On production, Chengdu prefecture, Huzhou and Yangzhou together supplied the north-west with bows and arrows counted in hundreds of thousands every year, while the warhorses came from the pastures of the north-west; a frontier siege and defence were paid for in bowstrings, arrow shafts, horse feed and grain.
cause: 起火點是李元昊不肯再做李繼遷那樣的附庸。李繼遷與宋周旋數十年，靠宋每年賜予的銀絹茶度日，也靠「先叛後受封」在宋夏之間取得實利；元昊即位後不再接受這套安排，康定元年前後遣使索取宋廷的正式官爵，宋廷議削其封號、停罷歲賜，改以節度使安置，甚至一度打算遷延州居民以虛其地。書信的往返最終破裂：元昊拒絕宋使的禮節、斷絕使臣往來，改元稱帝，隨即以兵相向。選擇延州作第一個目標有明確的戰略理由：延州是鄜延路的治所，北接麟州與府州，南可控綏州與坊州，東可窺同州與華州，扼住的是宋夏邊界的中樞；延州與周邊寨堡若落入夏手，宋在西北就失去一個可以反擊的支點，反之宋朝要反過來威脅夏的興慶府，也要先取延州。戰爭的深層背景，還包括宋夏之間二十餘年的羈縻統治本身難以為繼：宋廷每年賜銀絹並承認夏的官爵，本質是花錢買邊境安寧；元昊要的是國家形式的自主與實際的土地，這樣的交換已無餘地。此外，康定元年前後河東、河北一帶連年水旱、饑饉，邊民流移，陝西的軍需與民力都吃緊，宋廷既不能無限期加兵，也無法容忍延州這根釘子被拔掉，於是在增兵、加糧、修城三條路上同時被逼著做出了回應。
causeEn: The spark was Li Yuanhao's refusal to go on being a dependent of the Song as his father Li Jiqian had been. Li Jiqian had spent decades manoeuvring with the Song, surviving on the silver, silk and tea the court paid him every year and taking a real profit from the pattern of rebel first and enfeoffed afterwards; Yuanhao would not accept that arrangement any longer, and around Kangding year one he sent envoys to demand formal Song titles. The court stripped his titles, suspended the annual payments, proposed treating him instead as a circuit commissioner, and even considered moving the population of Yanzhou away to leave the ground empty. The exchange of letters ended in rupture: Yuanhao refused the Song envoy's ritual, cut off the coming and going of envoys, proclaimed himself emperor and changed his era, and then took up arms. Choosing Yanzhou as his first target had sound strategic reasoning: Yanzhou was the seat of Fuyan circuit, touching Linzhou and Fuzhou to the north, holding Suizhou and Fangzhou to the south and looking east towards Tongzhou and Huazhou, and it sat on the hinge of the Song-Xia border. If Yanzhou and its surrounding stockades fell, the Song would lose the one point in the north-west from which it could attack, and conversely, if the Song was ever to threaten the Xia capital at Xingqing it would have to take Yanzhou first. Behind that lay the deeper fact that more than twenty years of nominal subordination between the two states had become impossible to sustain: paying silver and silk and recognising Xia titles was, in essence, purchasing peace at the frontier, and Yuanhao wanted a state of his own with land in fact as well as in form. Add the conditions of the time: repeated floods, drought and famine around Hedong and Hebei around Kangding year one, border families moving away, and the grain and the manpower of Shaanxi all under strain. The Song could not reinforce indefinitely, and it could not tolerate the nail of Yanzhou being pulled out, so it was pushed onto three paths at once: more soldiers, more grain, and rebuilding the walls.
impact: 這場戰爭留下的第一樣東西，是一套延用到北宋後期甚至南宋的西北邊防辦法。范仲淹在延州推的城、寨、堡梯次，募邊民為弓箭手、屯田自給，以及以軍民合用取代純客軍屯駐的做法，日後在熙寧、元豐年間經營橫山時被曹瑋、種世衡一輩沿用放大，成為北宋對西夏作戰的基本樣式；「先固堡寨、再圖進取」的思路，也影響了此後宋夏戰爭中進攻與防守的比例，讓北宋在野戰屢挫之後仍能守住關中這一段。制度之外還有觀念的轉變：此戰之後，朝廷明白西北不是靠一次封賞就能買平的邊疆，兵源、糧源、屯田與城寨的密度成為衡量邊防的第一等事，這套認識在兵書編纂中落地，也讓火藥兵器在同一年代正式入書——慶曆四年(1044)刊行的《武經總要》著錄火藥箭與突火槍，正是武器史上一個關鍵節點。第二樣是代價：康定、慶曆之間的戰事把關中的民力、馬力與轉運線拉成一條長線，歲賜與增兵同時增加，陝西運輸線上的民夫與牛馬年年不絕；宋廷靠和議換來二十年的相對安寧，但也把對西夏的態勢固定在一個守成而又僵持的格局裡，橫山地區的爭奪此後仍然不斷。第三樣影響落在西夏自身：元昊雖在宋邊局部得手，卻因戰事消耗與內部整合而更需鞏固帝位，宋夏之間從羈縻轉為敵對的長期格局，在此之後再沒有回到李繼遷時代的每年換取銀帛。
impactEn: The first thing this war left behind was a system of north-western frontier defence that was used through the rest of the Northern Song and into the Southern Song. The tiering of city, fort and blockhouse that Fan Zhongyan built around Yanzhou, his enrolment of border households as archers, the farming garrisons that fed themselves, and the substitution of a mixed military-civilian garrison for purely professional troops were all followed and enlarged by Cao Wei and Zhong Shiheng when the Hengshan country was taken in during the Xining and Yuanfeng years, and became the basic pattern of Song warfare against Xia; the idea of consolidating the blockhouses before seeking anything further also fixed the ratio of attack to defence in later Song-Xia wars and allowed the Song to hold the stretch of Guanzhong despite repeated defeats in open battle. Beyond the institutions there was a change of mind: after this war the court understood that the north-west could not be bought quiet with a single act of enfeoffment, and that the density of soldiers, grain, farming garrisons and stockades was the first measure of frontier strength; that understanding was given written form in books like the Wujing Zongyao, and it is in the same decade that gunpowder weapons entered the military literature, the Wujing Zongyao printed in 1044 recording the gunpowder arrow and the fire lance, a turning point in the history of weapons. The second legacy was the cost: the fighting of the Kangding and Qingli years stretched the manpower, the horse power and the transport lines of Guanzhong into one long rope, with the annual payments and the reinforcements growing at the same time and the corvée teams and draught animals on the Shaanxi roads never idle; the court bought twenty years of relative peace by the settlement, but at the price of freezing the situation with Xia into a defensive and rigid stalemate, and the contest over the Hengshan country went on. The third effect fell on Xia itself: although Yuanhao had gained ground here and there on the Song border, the fighting and the consolidation of his own state absorbed him, and the fact that the Song-Xia relationship had moved from nominal submission to lasting enmity was never reversed to the state of annual payments in silver and silk that had obtained in the days of Li Jiqian.
result: 單看康定元年這一場，結果是西夏沒有打下延州：宋守軍靠城壘、弩砲與城頭的機動兵力把攻勢擋了回去，夏軍在延州城下久攻不克，轉而分兵他路，這條線上雙方未分勝負。但戰役的整體結果並不樂觀——西夏在同年先後取走綏德，宋軍在康定二年二月定川寨一役中損失慘重，兵馬死者以萬計的數字震動朝野，說明宋的邊防體系在最壞的情況下仍會崩潰。真正的變化發生在制度層面：范仲淹以陝西四路經略安撫副使兼知延州的身份接管防務，汰兵、練民、修城、築寨、屯田、重整驛遞，延州從此成為西北的支點而非弱點；其後大順城等堡寨相繼落成，宋軍的堡寨梯次防守成形，戰局在康定、慶曆之間慢慢扳平。戰爭沒有在延州城下決定勝負，而是在四年的消耗中以另一種方式收場：慶曆四年(1044)宋夏達成和議，夏取消帝號改稱臣，宋恢復歲賜、許其官號，邊界維持現狀。對宋來說，這是一場用兵與用政互相拉動的邊境戰爭：延州守住了，宋夏之間的和平多撐了二十多年；對西夏來說，雖然在鄜延、環慶一線得手，卻沒有能力東進，也沒有實力南下，於是建國初期那種銳氣漸漸收進了興慶府的城牆之內。
resultEn: Taken on its own, the result of Kangding year one is that Xia did not take Yanzhou. The Song garrison, relying on the walls, the crossbows and the catapults and on the mobile troops held back behind the parapets, turned the assault away; the Xia army could not take the city after a long siege and split its forces to other roads, and on that line neither side won. The wider outcome, however, was not good: Xia took Suizhou in the same year, and the Song suffered a heavy loss at Dingchuan stockade in Weizhou in the second month of Kangding year two, where the dead counted in tens of thousands and shook the court, showing that the Song frontier system would still collapse under the worst conditions. The real change happened at the level of institutions. Fan Zhongyan took charge of the defence as deputy commissioner of the four circuits of Shaanxi and governor of Yanzhou, weeded out soldiers, drilled the militia, repaired the walls, built stockades, opened farming garrisons and reworked the courier posts; Yanzhou from then on was a hinge of the north-west rather than a weak point, and the stockade at Dashun and others like it followed, so that the tiered defence of the Song took shape and the balance slowly came round during the Kangding and Qingli years. The war was not decided under the walls of Yanzhou but was closed after four years of attrition in a different way: in 1044 the Song and Xia reached a settlement, Xia gave up the imperial title and styled itself a vassal, the Song restored the annual payments and the titles, and the frontier stayed where it was. For the Song this was a frontier war in which the use of troops and the work of government pulled at each other: Yanzhou held, and the peace between the two states lasted more than another twenty years. For Xia, though it had gained ground along the Fuyan and Huanqing lines, it had neither the strength to strike east nor the strength to march south, so the sharpness of the early years of the new state gradually withdrew behind the walls of Xingqing.
